title: Gail Kim vs. Awesome Kong
summary: The early Knockouts division finds its defining rivalry in Gail Kim’s resilience against Awesome Kong’s power. A no-disqualification defense is followed by Kong finally taking the championship.

chapters.title: Gail survives without disqualifications
chapters.result: Gail Kim defeats Awesome Kong to retain the Knockouts title.
chapters.context: Kim must outlast a much larger challenger in a match where the usual protections of the rules are removed.

chapters.title: Kong finally overwhelms the champion
chapters.result: Awesome Kong defeats Gail Kim to win the Knockouts championship.
chapters.context: The television rematch turns Kong’s dominance into championship gold. The date follows the broadcast rather than the taping.
